children: Aerodrome Finance launches its SlipstreamV3 MEV tax on select pools on OP Mainnet. The pilot starts with conservative parameters to capture more value for liquidity providers (LPs) and sAERO holders.

The tax routes MEV value to LPs and sAERO holders through the participating pools. Value capture starts small under the pilot settings. Adding more pools and chains would expand the reach of the tax and the value it can route to these groups.
Aero will begin rolling out SlipstreamV3's new MEV tax on select pools on OP Mainnet today, capturing more value for LPs and sAERO holders.
This pilot starts with conservative parameters and is designed to collect data + optimize before expanding to more pools/chains over time.

title: Aerodrome Finance: SlipstreamV3 MEV tax goes live on OP Mainnet - 30 Oct 2026
